name: vecs-monorepo
description: Entity component system libraries for browser and Node.js

scripts.build: npm run build -w @vworlds/vecs && npm run build -w @vworlds/vecs-wire && npm run build -w @vworlds/vecs-protocol && npm run build -w @vworlds/vecs-client && npm run build -w @vworlds/vecs-server && npm run clean -w @vworlds/vecs-physics && npm run compile -w @vworlds/vecs-physics && npm run build -w @vworlds/vecs-phaser && npm run build -w @vworlds/vecs-phaser-server && npm run build -w @vworlds/vecs-phaser-client && npm run build -w @vworlds/vecs-demo-client --if-present && npm run build -w @vworlds/vecs-demo-server --if-present
scripts.format: prettier --write . --ignore-unknown && prettier --write --plugin=prettier-plugin-sh "scripts/**/*.sh" ".agents/skills/release/release.sh" "apps/*/docker/*.sh" && prettier --write --plugin=prettier-plugin-nginx --parser nginx "apps/*/docker/nginx.conf" && dockerfmt -w -n apps/*/docker/Dockerfile
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . --ignore-unknown && prettier --check --plugin=prettier-plugin-sh "scripts/**/*.sh" ".agents/skills/release/release.sh" "apps/*/docker/*.sh" && prettier --check --plugin=prettier-plugin-nginx --parser nginx "apps/*/docker/nginx.conf" && dockerfmt -c -n apps/*/docker/Dockerfile
